conflict_resolutions.conflict: Six 7x7 shared-feedback solves vs 48-variable virtual-body optimizer vs direct Cartesian correction
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Select minimal six 7x7 velocity solves plus <=3x3 native-derived planar twist. All plans identify body/contact coupling; shared twist and release arbitration cover that boundary without introducing a virtual-body prediction optimizer. Efficacy remains falsifiable.

conflict_resolutions.conflict: Distal force acquisition mandatory vs stable proximal support sufficient
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Keep selected law distal30 controller transition, never scientific acceptance substitution. Delete correctly notes distal force is not universal support; conservative refusal is a declared stall failure, not exclusion or successful gait.

conflict_resolutions.conflict: Phase trajectories, catch-up and deadlines differ
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Keep selected three equal swing segments, 2x catch-up, pi/2 maximum debt, 500 active-tick wait and reacquisition. No averaging of constants or cycle skipping.

Keep selected two per-release native phase endpoint poses with fixed actual root/passives, unit magnitude and latched r scale; no384-call calibration or outcome fitting. Zero excursion remains a measured failure possibility.

conflict_resolutions.conflict: Capture point vs fixed-horizon COM screen and extra body predicates
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Keep selected capture-point hull with .02mm margin and up>.8; add only positive nonfoot release veto from structural observation ownership. This is explicitly a conservative heuristic, not a support wrench proof.

conflict_resolutions.conflict: Position bounds, correction gain and native preload strategy differ
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Keep exact minimal rate800*C and radius80*C corrections, compiled range intersection and velocity landing law. No structural2200 or deleteB/T slew, no ground clipping, gain45/force65 unchanged.
